inputs.text: France has convicted Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame, under a new law targeting “psychological subjection.” That should worry anyone who values religious freedom: when the state claims authority to judge spiritual influence, traditional communities can be put at risk under a law whose reach is already controversial. Social order matters, but so does keeping government power within clear limits.
